title: Principal UX Designer
description:
Dropbox is seeking a Principal UX Designer who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Principal UX Designer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our design capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute design initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 7+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in UI/UX, Project Management, Design Systems, Leadership
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: NPR 400,000 – NPR 800,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

title: Senior Account Executive
description:

description:

- Hybrid work options available
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

We are looking for a talented Mid-Level Security Engineer to join our dynamic team at Pinterest. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining tech solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

- 7 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in React, JavaScript, Analytical Thinking, Team Management
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of NPR 1,400,000 – NPR 2,400,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- Hybrid work options available
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

description:

Join Shopify as a Lead Brand Manager and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Lead Brand Manager with strong expertise in marketing. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prioritize, and execute marketing projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

**Must-Have Qualifications:**
- Minimum 1 years of experience as a Lead Brand Manager or similar
- In-depth knowledge of HubSpot, Problem Solving, SEO, Facebook Ads
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: NPR 800,000 – NPR 1,400,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities

description:

Join Slack as a Mid-Level HR Manager and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Mid-Level HR Manager with strong expertise in general. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prioritize, and execute general projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

**Must-Have Qualifications:**
- Minimum 4 years of experience as a Mid-Level HR Manager or similar
- In-depth knowledge of Stakeholder Management, Analytical Thinking, Communication, Leadership
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: NPR 800,000 – NPR 1,400,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities

title: Principal Account Executive
description:
We are looking for a talented Principal Account Executive to join our dynamic team at Doist. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining finance solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**
- 1 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in Excel, SAP, Microsoft Office, Auditing
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of NPR 1,400,000 – NPR 2,400,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- Hybrid work options available
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

We are looking for a talented Director of Mobile Developer to join our dynamic team at United Airlines. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining tech solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**
- 6 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in JavaScript, Python, Git, Leadership
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of NPR 4,000,000 – NPR 7,000,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- Hybrid work options available
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

title: Director of Warehouse Manager
description:
Join Indeed as a Director of Warehouse Manager and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Director of Warehouse Manager with strong expertise in general. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prioritize, and execute general projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

**Must-Have Qualifications:**
- Minimum 8 years of experience as a Director of Warehouse Manager or similar
- In-depth knowledge of Communication, Analytical Thinking, Stakeholder Management, Problem Solving
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: NPR 800,000 – NPR 1,400,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities
